programmes.show_description: Drama series about an elite sex investigation force. A ritualistic killing leads to the discovery that children are being smuggled from Nigeria and sold into slavery.
Drama series. A woman with a high-risk pregnancy is kidnapped as she approaches her delivery date and Benson and Stabler are faced with more than one suspect.
Crime drama series. The team probes the connection between the deaths of two high school students and an illegal marketing campaign by a major pharmaceutical company.
Frank investigates when an undercover officer accuses a fellow cop of police brutality. Danny and Baez investigate the murder of a famous photographer recently accused of assault.
Danny and Baez work with Texas Ranger Waylon Gates to track the Lone Star Killer. After Eddie's partner mistakenly shoots an undercover cop, Jamie is accused of poor supervision.
A man has a hard time making his case when a bag of illicit items has his name on it. A talkative driver tells officers a long story with conflicting details.

A daily round-up of showbiz news and gossip from around the world, focusing on celebrities, movies, music and entertainment.
The team investigates the cause of a mysterious death involving an NCIS armoury employee that was discovered four months after the Navy Yard bombings.
While on medical leave, Ducky decides to reopen a 12-year-old case by ordering the exhumation of a Navy commander's body.
The NCIS team investigate a helicopter crash on shore and have to locate the missing pilot. Meanwhile, Ziva issues a dare to Tony and McGee.
A daily round-up of showbiz news and gossip from around the world, focusing on celebrities, movies, music and entertainment.
Crime drama. A handgun found at an arson crime scene leads detectives to arrest a man in connection with an old murder.
Flaw: New episode of crime drama. Detective Olivia Benson assists Fontana and Green as they probe the death of a con man who tried to call Benson just before he was murdered (2/22).
Ghosts: Crime drama. A deathbed confession prompts Fontana and Green to re-open a ten-year-old murder case. Fontana's unorthodox methods bring him into conflict with McCoy (3/22).
America, Inc.: The murder of a private defence contractor is linked to an atrocity in Iraq. A shocking twist in the case forces McCoy to make an unpalatable decision (17/22).
Thinking Makes It So: Crime drama. A foiled bank robbery leads police to uncover the kidnapping of a young girl. Fontana resorts to heavy-handed tactics to locate the child (18/22).
Positive: Drama series. The shooting of a hospital administrator leads Fontana and Green to probe the death of an AIDS-stricken girl (19/22).
A daily round-up of showbiz news and gossip from around the world, focusing on celebrities, movies, music and entertainment.
Prime Suspect: US naval police series. A media frenzy surrounding an unidentified criminal prompts Gibbs's barber to question his son as a prime suspect.
US crime series. The wife of a marine who specialised in K-9 bomb detection urges the NCIS team to investigate the recent death of her husband in Afghanistan.
Squall: US crime series. A storm brings the team aboard the USS Borealis, where everyone becomes a suspect once the crime scene proves that Mother Nature wasn't the only culprit.
The BAU investigates a series of killings with the same M.O. seen in the strike team deaths. The team tries to link the victims to determine if they are dealing with the same killer.
Drama series about an elite force based in New York which investigates sexually oriented crimes. The investigation into the death of a teenager exposes a family secret.
Drama series about an elite force based in New York which investigates sex crimes. A mentally ill woman's paranoia intensifies after her husband is murdered.
Drama series about an elite force investigating sex crimes. Benson and Stabler investigate the near-fatal beating of a psychiatrist, possibly by one of her patients.
Drama series. A suspect is charged with the rape and murder of an undercover federal agent, and as the trial approaches, Cabot receives death threats.
NCIS probe a Navy lieutenant's death at a blood bank while McGee seeks team support for his twins' school fundraiser.
When a music mogul is found dead, Shaw and Riley clash with an undercover officer unwilling to cooperate.
Officers are dumbfounded when a man tries to talk them into taking him to jail. Sparks fly when a driver tries to take his truck on the freeway with only two wheels.

A petty officer gunned down in a billionaire's Ferrari leads the NCIS team to uncover an unexpected link to Gibbs.
When a lieutenant who has just returned from the Middle East is found dead, the NCIS team wants to interrogate the victim's friend.
Gibbs continues to work with Captain Wescott while he retraces his steps in order to help the team track down a terrorist.
Age Of Innocence: Crime drama. A car bomb kills a man who was fighting to terminate the life of his comatose wife. Fontana and Green investigate a host of pro-life campaigners (4/22).
Crime drama. Fontana and Green probe the murder of an undercover journalist who was investigating a notorious Latino gang (5/22).
A daily round-up of showbiz news and gossip from around the world, focusing on celebrities, movies, music and entertainment.
Birthright: Crime drama. The death of a teenage girl in custody is linked to an illegal contraceptive implant, which was fitted without the girl's knowledge (6/22).
Kingmaker: American legal drama series. An undercover police officer is brutally murdered by an Albanian drug dealer after her cover is blown in a newspaper column. (20/22).
Hindsight: Crime drama. Detective Green's one-time replacement, Nick Falco, is implicated in the murder of a young woman (16/21).
Fame: A botched burglary ends in murder, and the apartment in question belongs to a paparazzi who may have compromising photos of a celebrity and her baby.
US naval crime drama series. When a Navy reservist returns home to find her husband missing and her living room covered in blood, she turns to the NCIS team.
US naval crime drama series. While the team investigates the murder of a Mossad officer in Virginia, Tony and Ziva depart for Berlin as they track Ziva's father's killer.
Revenge: US naval crime drama series. In retaliation for the murders of Eli David and Jackie Vance, the NCIS team searches for Bodnar, despite orders to relinquish the case.
Jamie is under investigation after his police vest is found on a perpetrator. Danny and Baez investigate the suspicious circumstances surrounding the death of a hotel employee.
Frank and Garrett try to convince Mayor Chase to cooperate in running the city. Danny and Baez track down the person who vandalized NYPD vehicles with anti-cop graffiti.
Drama series about an elite force based in New York. A group of high school bullies are convicted for torturing and murdering one of their own gang.
